recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Revisit only if FHIR-I wants an explicit Resource.meta example, since the current implementer-facing rule is already present and extra prose would be redundant rather than corrective.
issue_request: FHIR-17271 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core change request from STU3 asking that the FHIRPath appendix document that expression roots may be supertypes, not only concrete resource types, with Resource.meta as the motivating example.
initial_application: The issue appears to have been applied by git-svn commit 8fdac31e0560608aef30d5014be84001f5653a50, whose GF#17271 message and git-svn revision 13919 match the Jira comment. That commit added the source/fhirpath.html prose about full resource-name roots and supertype roots.
additional_context: The originating Zulip thread confirms Resource.meta.lastUpdated polymorphic-root use in search parameters was intentional and led to GF#17271. Current source still contains Resource-level search parameters using Resource.meta.* expressions. Confluence and Jira neighborhood searches found no later conflicting decision for this narrow behavior.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current active source/fhirpath.html page already states that FHIRPath statements can start with full resource names, that the name can include supertypes such as DomainResource, and that these statements apply to any resource specializing that supertype.
